Strategic Goal:
Reducing direct and indirect negative environmental impact by targeting interventions
in reforestation and afforestation, green innovation, waste management, among others

Enhancing education outcomes that lead to future jobs by supporting vulnerable
children, including youth with disability, access quality education and key life skills

Empowering youth and micro, small and medium enterprises (MSMEs) by improving
their skillset and enhancing their networking opportunities

Networking with philanthropy groups to support initiatives aimed at developing local
philanthropy and growing a culture of giving that leads to sustainable development
Supporting community-based initiatives that respond to local grass root needs
